command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj RV-P1-add-register.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one line each (LF, trailing newline): `add a0, a1, a2` / `add a5, a6, a7` / `add a0, zero, a1`. Registers are the target's own numbering, so a0=10, a1=11, a2=12, a5=15, a6=16, a7=17, zero=0.
